## TL;DR

<!-- One sentence: who hits this, and what breaks for them. -->

## What is happening?

<!-- The actual, observed behavior. Include the exact error, status code or
     output where you have it -- not a paraphrase. -->

## What should happen?

<!-- The behavior a correct implementation would have. If this contradicts
     an accepted decision or ADR, name it and explain why the current
     behavior seems wrong anyway, rather than silently proposing something
     the decision register already ruled out. -->

## Reproduction

<!-- Exact steps, a minimal repro, or a commit/PR where the behavior was
     introduced. "Sometimes happens" is a reason to keep looking before
     filing, not a description. -->

## Extra context

<!-- Relevant decisions (docs/decisions.md), ADRs, related issues, or logs.
     Never paste live credentials, secrets or another user's data here --
     see SECURITY.md if the bug is itself a vulnerability. -->
